{{Quote|Captain Ardle from Corrupter here. We’re Thyferran Home Defense Corps pilots. Does that make a difference in your offer?|Captain Ardle to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="bacta" />}}
'''Ardle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. Ardle and his squadron [[Second ambush in the Graveyard|fought]] against former members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] at [[the Graveyard]].<ref name="bacta" />

After their capital ship the [[Corrupter/Legends|''Corrupter'']], a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]], was destroyed, Ardle and the remaining TIE's surrendered to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], the leader of the former Rogues.<ref name="bacta" />
